newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Romania's Health Ministry reported 482 meningitis cases and. So far 38 people died because of the disease. The virus has yet to be identified.
* Signing of Romanian-Hungary treaty has marked a turning point in bilateral ties, said Traian Chebeleu, spokesman of President Ion Iliescu.
* Senate passed a bill on hospitals.
It has also ratified the Romanian-Yugoslav friendship treaty signed earlier this year.
* Lower Chamber of Deputies starts debates on bill on staff in education system.
* Industry Ministry said 85 percent of furniture output is exported.
